title: Agent Pay failure: the keyid is not in the key directory
summary: An agent sends a signed request that passes the tag, field, timestamp and nonce checks, but the verifier cannot find its keyid in Mastercard's key directory, for example an unregistered or delisted agent. Mastercard's checklist says to block.

steps.label: Signed request, unknown keyid
steps.detail: The request carries complete Signature-Input parameters, a window under 8 minutes, a fresh nonce and the Agent Pay tag, but the key was never registered or is no longer listed. keyid and signature are placeholders.

payload.content:
# Illustrative example, Agent Pay developer guides as read 2026-10-21. Placeholder values; the signature does not verify.
GET /checkout HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.example.com
Signature-Agent: "https://agent-keys.example.com/"
Signature-Input: sig1=("@authority" "@path");created=1791720000;expires=1791720480;keyid="<key-thumbprint>";alg="ed25519";nonce="<random-nonce>";tag="Agent-pay-auth"
Signature: sig1=:<signature>:

steps.label: Look up keyid
steps.detail: After the timestamp and nonce checks pass, the verifier looks up keyid; the directory returns no key.

steps.label: Block
steps.detail: Mastercard's checklist says a key that cannot be retrieved for keyid means block. The agent never reaches the card form.

steps.label: Log the attempt
steps.detail: The merchant or edge keeps the event for bot analytics. Mastercard publishes no event name for it.
